The Briseño Lab develops open-source software for environmental data, virome ecology, and viral bioinformatics. Our tools are designed to make complex analyses more reproducible and easier to reuse across research projects.

## [BBioinfo](pipelines.qmd)

## Open and reproducible research

We share source code, documentation, worked examples, and issue trackers whenever a tool is ready for public use. Released tools can be cited through their package or repository record. Software under active development is labeled clearly so users can distinguish stable releases from emerging methods.

Questions, feature requests, and contributions are welcome through the linked GitHub repositories or the [lab contact page](../contact/).
